title: SiteVisits
description: One reporting event at a location on a date. The unit of submission and review.

ProjectID.description: Required in storage, never a routine question (D-22). Trusted system data; never inferred from a photograph (D-19). References Projects.ProjectID

LocationID.description: Required in storage, confirmed rather than typed (D-22). Validation: Location must belong to ProjectID References Locations.LocationID

VisitDate.description: Never typed on the normal path. Correctable by an authorised user (spec 7.3).

SupervisorUserID.description: Resolved from the authenticated identity; must hold an active assignment to ProjectID. References Users.UserID

OverallDescriptionEN.description: NOT mandatory. A normal submission is established by photographs. A written description is required only in the declared exceptional workflows. Validation: Optional for a normal photographic submission (D-18)

OverallDescriptionAR.description: A supervisor may write in either language; both are carried to the report (D-11). Validation: Optional for a normal photographic submission (D-18)

AdditionalSiteNote.description: For facts a photograph cannot establish (D-18). Speech-to-text is a future input method for this field, not a new field. Validation: Optional. Mandatory only in the exceptional workflows listed in capture_once.optional_note.mandatory_exceptions

SiteNoteCategory.description: Classifies the optional note so it can be routed and reported. Never inferred by AI.

CaptureMode.description: Quick Share is the default so the contractor group is served first and nothing is waited for (D-22). Both modes capture the images exactly once (D-16).

ShareStatus.description: Recorded from the supervisor's confirmation. The app cannot observe delivery inside the messaging application.

ShareTargetLabel.description: A label for the destination group, held as project configuration. NEVER a telephone number, group invitation link or messaging identifier (D-19).

ShareAttemptCount.description: Incremented on every share attempt. A retry re-uses the stored evidence and must never ask the supervisor to select the images again (CAP-01).

ClientAcknowledgementStatus.description: A CLAIM recorded on site. Never treated as a client approval (A-20). Validation: NotRequested|Claimed|Declined

RejectionReason.description: Mandatory when returning a record for correction.

ValidationErrors.description: Specific correctable errors from server-side validation, never a generic message.

CorrelationID.description: Links this record to its orchestration jobs and audit entries.

EntityVersion.description: Incremented on every material change. Referenced by Approvals.

ContentHash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical serialisation of the fields listed in content_hash_fields.
